{{Quote|I had this lightsaber constructed in ''imitation'' of those carried once by Jedi Knights. I'm ''saving'' it for the day when I can pay Darth Vader back in ''kind'' for what he did to me.|Orman Tagge to Silas Tagge|<ref name="SW 31" />}}
An '''imitation lightsaber''' was owned by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tagge had the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] constructed as an imitation of the [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] once carried by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], hoping to use it in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] against [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SW 31" />

Orman Tagge, the head of the [[House of Tagge/Legends|Tagge family]], chose to conduct the experiments that led to the saber's creation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Those experiments were performed by the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] under the auspices of head of science [[Silas Tagge/Legends|Silas Tagge]], the brother of Orman. Orman explained to Silas that the experiments were performed on Tatooine in part to draw the attention of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member and [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi aspirant]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Tatooine was Skywalker's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and Orman sought to lure Skywalker back to attract the attention of Darth Vader, against whom Orman sought revenge.<ref name="SW 31" />

[[File:Duel_aboard_the_Tagge_Mining_Explorer.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Orman Tagge duels Luke Skywalker.]]
Eventually this lightsaber saw its use when Orman Tagge [[Duel aboard the Tagge Mining Explorer|dueled]] the Rebel Luke Skywalker aboard the Tagge Company [[Mining Explorer]]. Tagge managed to hold his own against Skywalker and briefly overpowered him until the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] skillfully defeated Tagge by slicing his goggles in half, which left the Baron in shock.<ref name="SW 33">[[Star Wars (1977) 33|''Star Wars'' (1977) 33]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The lightsaber first appeared in the [[Star Wars (1977) 31|thirty-first issue]] of [[Marvel Comics]]{{'}} [[1977]] [[Star Wars (1977)|comic series]] entitled ''Star Wars''.<ref name="SW 31" /> The issue was first made available to purchase on [[October 23]], [[1979]].<ref name="tcr">[[Wikipedia:The Comic Reader|''The Comic Reader'']] #173 and ''The Comics Journal'' #50, provided by Marvel</ref>
